base_info.sourceDataProductName: ESA CCI Land Cover PFT v2.0.81
base_info.description: Sum of class percentage cover averaged over 300 m pixels with centres within 1 km great-circle distance of the site, divided by 100. With time_placement constant, the mean over years is used at all time steps; with annual, each year's value fills that year.

treeFrac.nameLong: tree cover fraction from ESA CCI Land Cover PFT v2.0.81, mean within 1 km

shrubFrac.nameLong: shrub cover fraction from ESA CCI Land Cover PFT v2.0.81, mean within 1 km

grassFrac.nameLong: grass cover fraction from ESA CCI Land Cover PFT v2.0.81, mean within 1 km

bareFrac.nameLong: bare cover fraction from ESA CCI Land Cover PFT v2.0.81, mean within 1 km

vegFrac.nameLong: vegetation cover fraction from ESA CCI Land Cover PFT v2.0.81, mean within 1 km

treeFrac_insitu.nameLong: Tree fraction, in situ where available else ESA CCI Land Cover PFT v2.0.81
treeFrac_insitu.sourceDataProductName: FLUXNET_veg_frac.csv and ESA CCI Land Cover PFT v2.0.81
treeFrac_insitu.description: FLUXNET_veg_frac.csv frac_overstory for forest and savanna PFTs and 0 for other PFTs in the csv, otherwise the product tree fraction, capped at the merged vegetation fraction

vegFrac_insitu.nameLong: Vegetation fraction, in situ where available else ESA CCI Land Cover PFT v2.0.81
vegFrac_insitu.sourceDataProductName: FLUXNET_veg_frac.csv and ESA CCI Land Cover PFT v2.0.81
vegFrac_insitu.description: FLUXNET_veg_frac.csv as 1 - frac_soil, or overstory + understory without soil, averaged over rows of a site, otherwise the product vegetation fraction
